stories.title: World Mental Health Day: charity shares stories of two young Flintshire women
stories.summary: A care leaver from Holywell and a young carer from Broughton are among 514 young people supported by charity WeMindTheGap in 2025/26. The charity has shared their stories, with names changed, to mark World Mental Health Day today, Saturday October 10. Rachel, 18, a care leaver from Holywell, receives professional support for anxiety and depression.

stories.title: Weekend story sessions for young children begin at Abakhan bookshop in Mostyn
stories.summary: A children’s bookshop at Abakhan in Mostyn has started weekend storytelling sessions for young children and their families. stories.title: Flintshire council proposes double yellow lines on A5026 Fron Park Road in Holywell
